capabilities: Render glosses and translations below text
Draw bouten emphasis dots, overlines, and underlines
Provide Reading view and Live Preview rendering
disambiguation: Not a general Markdown editor extension; it only adds inline annotation syntax and rendering for Obsidian notes.
extras: Part of a monorepo that also ships a reference parser, a specification with fixtures, and ports for markdown-it, Marked, VS Code, Logseq, and SilverBullet; the README notes Logseq highlight parsing can conflict with multiple ^^() expressions in one block.
intentEvidence: It implements the syntax proposed by Baksi Li in Ruby (Furigana) Syntax in Markdown.
problem: Standard Markdown has no way to write phonetic readings, interlinear glosses, or emphasis marks above and below text.
